tasks.title: Read the shift briefing
tasks.description: Your supervisor left tonight's briefing in Mail.
tasks.hint: Double-click Mail and open the unread briefing from Ruth Hale.
tasks.hintDeck: Press A twice on Mail and open the unread briefing from Ruth Hale.

tasks.title: Archive Batch 47 (3 files)
tasks.description: Batch 47 has been verified. Move batch47_a, batch47_b and batch47_c from Intake to Archive.
tasks.hint: Drag each batch47 file from Intake onto the Archive folder. Damaged files can still be archived.
tasks.hintDeck: Hold R2 on each batch47 file in Intake and drop it on the Archive folder. Damaged files can still be archived.

tasks.title: Verify work order #3330
tasks.description: Check the drive owner's status in Personnel. Approve the wipe only if the owner is TERMINATED.
tasks.hint: Work Orders, then Personnel. If the owner is not TERMINATED, click Reject.

tasks.title: Verify work order #3331
tasks.description: Check the drive owner's status in Personnel. Approve the wipe only if the owner is TERMINATED.
tasks.hint: Work Orders, then Personnel. If the owner is not TERMINATED, click Reject.

tasks.title: Shred ~nxs0150.tmp
tasks.description: A temporary cache file is taking up space in Intake. Shred it.
tasks.hint: Drag ~nxs0150.tmp onto the Disposal bin, then confirm.
tasks.hintDeck: Hold R2 on ~nxs0150.tmp and drop it on the Disposal bin, then confirm.

tasks.title: Archive Batch 48 (2 files)
tasks.description: Batch 48 has been verified. Move batch48_a and batch48_b from Intake to Archive.
tasks.hint: Drag each batch48 file from Intake onto the Archive folder.
tasks.hintDeck: Hold R2 on each batch48 file in Intake and drop it on the Archive folder.

tasks.title: Wait for Custodial rounds (3:00 AM)
tasks.description: Your queue is clear. Custodial starts a full round at 3:00 AM and Security will open the Camera Viewer. Stay seated.
tasks.hint: Nothing to do until then. Read your mail while you wait.

tasks.title: Shelf check: Sublevel C (3 orders)
tasks.description: Retention requires a shelf check during rounds. Compare each order's listed shelf with the label on CAM 04. Approve only if the owner's number is on that shelf.
tasks.hint: Open Work Orders and the Camera Viewer. CAM 04 shows shelves 12 to 19 in order and names the NEXT one. If the viewer keeps closing, you are watching the custodian: check Personnel 000 for where Custodial is and watch a different camera.
tasks.hintDeck: Open Work Orders and the Camera Viewer. CAM 04 shows shelves 12 to 19 in order and names the NEXT one. If the viewer keeps closing, you are watching the custodian: check Personnel 000 for where Custodial is and watch a different camera.

tasks.title: PUT ME IN THE BIN
tasks.description:
Added by remote session 017.
Not assigned by Night Operations.
Target: employee_017.dat to the Disposal bin
tasks.hint: Drag employee_017.dat from the Desktop onto the Disposal bin and confirm. Session 017 holds on: keep the button held and drag away from its pointer.
tasks.hintDeck: Hold R2 on employee_017.dat on the Desktop, drop it on the Disposal bin and confirm. Session 017 holds on: keep R2 held and pull away from its pointer.
